node.label: Marcel Mauss
node.date_label: “Essai sur la nature et la fonction du sacrifice,” with Henri Hubert (1899) · Sacrifice essay reprinted in Mélanges d’histoire des religions (1909) · “Essai sur le don” (1925) · The Gift: Jane I. Guyer’s expanded English edition (2016)
node.description: Examines obligations and ritual relations across law, religion and economy. The selected Gift introduction asks why apparently voluntary gifts entail giving back and treats exchange as embedded in several institutions rather than as isolated transactions between self-contained individuals. His comparative programme identifies selected areas and documentary limits; its historical vocabulary and sweeping formulations remain attributable to its period. With Henri Hubert, the earlier sacrifice essay offers a provisional account of ritual mediation between sacred and profane. The two projects have different questions and credits, and later translations or collections do not make them interchangeable.
node.representative_figures_and_works: With Henri Hubert, “Essai sur la nature et la fonction du sacrifice” (1899; 1909 reprint); “Essai sur le don” (published 1925 in L’Année sociologique volume labelled 1923–1924); The Gift, expanded English edition translated by Jane I. Guyer (2016).
node.scope_note: Existing identity and Durkheim/anthropology/practice contexts preserved. New original-language introduction reading supplements but does not erase the older publisher-only gift scope. Sacrifice retains Hubert’s coauthorship. Original, reprint, journal-volume and translation dates differ; Guyer’s 2016 expanded edition is not the start of the work. No whole original essay or detailed cases newly read.
